verdict.rationale: The only geographic signal is that payments run over local rails, Faster Payments in the UK and SEPA in Europe. That implies UK/European reach but says nothing about which or how many institutions are covered. Institution-level features are referenced in the API docs, but no published coverage list or counts appear in the evidence. Missing for 10: published institution counts, a per-country coverage list, a searchable institution directory, independent corroboration of coverage claims.
